answer: Quick check first — last I heard, back in November you'd jumped internally to the infra team and Go became your daily driver, with the Kotlin ingestion rewrite being the chapter before that. If your team is still on a Kotlin codebase, the standard combo is ktlint for formatting plus detekt for static analysis, both wired into Gradle and a pre-commit hook so CI and local stay in sync. But if it's the Go team you're setting up now, I'd point you at gofmt/goimports plus golangci-lint instead — which one are we outfitting?
